title: Rosemary Beach: Point of View Cottage in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season. Book your reservation today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Point of View Cottage is a stone's throw away from the Cabana Pool and all the amenities of the Town Center.

This standalone house has two private king bedrooms upstairs, each with its own private bath, and a half bath downstairs. It is located right on the boardwalk that leads directly to 2500 feet of glorious white sand beaches and the blue waters of the Gulf of Mexico about 400 yards away The house is also perfectly situated next to the cabana pool and a gated playground. The house has driveway parking for two cars!

For your comfort, the primary bedroom has a king bed with its own private bath and balcony. The other bedroom has a king bed and its own private bath. Each bedroom has its own 40” flat screen Roku TV. The kitchen is equipped with all the modern appliances and conveniences to assure your cooking pleasure. Porches off the upstairs master bedroom and downstairs living area provide a comfortable setting for soaking in the beautiful scenery. In addition, there is a private patio off the kitchen with a gas grill and eating area to cook and enjoy a steak or freshly-caught fish. There’s also an outdoor shower on to wash all the sand off!

The Rosemary Beach Community has a total of four pools (one indoor and heated for cooler temperatures), tennis courts, and a gym with a weight room. First-class restaurants and shops are within walking distance. Additionally, there are five golf courses within 20 miles of the house. We have 4 adult bicycles for you to enjoy the 30-A bicycle trail which connects the nearby coastal communities of Seagrove, Seaside, Watercolor, and Grayton Beach. In addition, we have a wagon to tote all your beach gear to the beach.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

Need more space? Check out the carriage house listing here: Point of View Carriage House
